stem: Which sentence should replace sentence 31 to bring this paper to a more effective conclusion?

options.label: A
options.text: Community celebrations are happening all over the country, and they will continue to happen for many years to come.

options.label: B
options.text: The best community celebrations are the ones in which many people participate in the planning and maintain good attitudes.

options.label: C
options.text: Community celebrations can be good for the health of both individuals and the community they have chosen to call home.

options.label: D
options.text: People should consider attending a community celebration to meet others in their community and make good friends.
